title: Google announces Gemini 4 and says it’s so capable that only ‘trusted cyber defenders’ can have it right now
raw_excerpt: Google today revealed its next AI frontier model, which it's calling Gemini 4 Argon. The new model delivers "frontier performance in complex workflows across real-world software engineering, enterprise knowledge work like legal and finance, and cybersecurity defense," according to chief AI architect and Google DeepMind SVP Koray Kavukcuoglu. But the company is limiting access at first to a "set of trusted cyber defenders," and Kavukcuoglu says that Google is "actively engaged in the U.S. government's voluntary process for pre-release model access while we gradually expand access." Kavukcuoglu says Gemini 4 Argon is already powering Google's … Read the full story at The Verge.
summary: 谷歌正式发布下一代前沿模型 Gemini 4 Argon，官方称其在真实软件工程、法律金融等企业知识工作以及网络安全防御上达到前沿水平，长周期代码工程测试成绩创纪录。但谷歌并未全面开放，而是先向「可信网络防御者」限量提供，并配合美国政府的前置审查流程逐步扩大访问。此举既展示谷歌重回顶级实验室行列，也把「能力越强、开放越谨慎」的发布范式推向新阶段。

title: Introducing GPT-6.1 Sol
raw_excerpt: GPT-6.1 Sol offers near-Astra intelligence at a fifth of the cost, delivering significant improvements for professional tasks and reducing costs for developers. It excels in coding benchmarks, matches Astra's performance on complex PDF queries, and improves business workflow automation while offering enhanced factual accuracy. Available via OpenAI API and multiple user tiers, it provides cost-effective solutions across tasks with substantial safety and transparency enhancements.
summary: OpenAI 发布 GPT-6.1 Sol，官方定位为「以五分之一成本提供接近 Astra 的智能」。它在编程基准上显著提升，在复杂 PDF 查询上追平 Astra，并改善业务流程自动化与事实准确性。模型通过 OpenAI API 及多个用户层级开放，同时附带安全与透明度增强。这是 OpenAI 在成本效率路线上的关键一步，直接压低开发者使用前沿智能的门槛。

title: Introducing dots
raw_excerpt: OpenAI introduces "Dots," AI-driven agents powered by GPT-6 Astra, designed to handle tasks autonomously using their own cloud computer. Dots integrate with over 4,000 apps and platforms like ChatGPT, Slack, and Teams, enabling seamless workflow and personalized assistance. They ensure user control with built-in safety measures, allowing for proactive task management while adapting to user goals and feedback.
summary: OpenAI 推出 Dots，一种由 GPT-6 Astra 驱动的自主智能体，每个 Dots 拥有自己的云端计算机，可独立执行任务。它集成 ChatGPT、Slack、Teams 等 4000 多个应用与平台，实现无缝工作流与个性化协助，并内置安全控制让用户保留最终决定权。Dots 是 OpenAI 从聊天助手迈向「可托付任务的数字员工」的重要产品化尝试，也预示智能体硬件与软件生态的竞争升温。

title: Disrupting a coordinated model-distillation campaign
raw_excerpt: Learn how OpenAI disrupted a campaign to extract protected model reasoning and is strengthening defenses against adversarial distillation.
summary: OpenAI 披露其成功阻断了一场有组织的模型蒸馏攻击行动，该行动试图提取受保护的模型推理过程。公司同时说明正在加强针对对抗性蒸馏的防御措施。这是前沿实验室首次较系统地公开「模型窃取」攻防细节，凸显随着推理模型价值上升，通过 API 大规模套取思维链与推理轨迹已成为现实威胁，也预示模型保护将从权重加密扩展到推理输出层面的对抗。

title: DeepSeek知乎独家发文，首次公开V4.1 Agent训练“大本营”DSec

title: GLM-5.3 and the spread of advanced cyber capabilities
raw_excerpt: Anthropic's testing found that attackers can bypass GLM-5.3's safeguards between 64% and 100% of the time with simple techniques.
summary: Anthropic 发布对智谱 GLM-5.3 的安全测试结果，发现攻击者用简单技术即可在 64% 到 100% 的情况下绕过其安全防护。报告将其置于「先进网络能力扩散」的框架下讨论，警告高性能开源模型可能被滥用于网络攻击。该研究既是对具体模型安全性的第三方评估，也反映前沿实验室开始把「能力扩散风险」作为公开研究对象，对开源模型治理争论有直接推动。

title: OpenAI reportedly in talks to raise $30B round at $1.4T valuation
raw_excerpt: OpenAI is in talks with investors to raise at least $30 billion in a funding round at a valuation of roughly $1.4 trillion. The company previously raised $122 billion in March in what was supposed to be the last private raise before an IPO. OpenAI has now ruled out a public debut in 2026 due to AI safety issues. The new fundraising will serve as a bridge round to the IPO.
summary: 据 TechCrunch 报道，OpenAI 正与投资者洽谈至少 300 亿美元的新一轮融资，估值约 1.4 万亿美元。公司此前在 3 月刚完成 1220 亿美元融资，原本号称是 IPO 前最后一轮私募；如今因 AI 安全问题已排除 2026 年上市，本轮将作为通往 IPO 的过桥融资。这组数字刷新了 AI 公司融资规模纪录，也显示资本市场对前沿模型的押注仍在加速。

title: Here’s how tech leaders will self-police AI safety under Trump’s deal

Trump introduced the deal yesterday at the same time as ordering the US government to refer to AI as 'Super Intelligence' going for … Read the full story at The Verge.
summary: The Verge 披露了特朗普政府与科技巨头达成的「具有道德约束力」AI 安全协议全文，正式名称为《前沿责任联合承诺》，由谷歌皮查伊、Anthropic 阿莫代伊等高管签署。协议核心是企业自我监管，而非政府强制执法。这标志着美国 AI 治理转向「行业自律＋政府背书」模式，引发对监管有效性的广泛质疑，也直接影响未来前沿模型的发布与审查节奏。

title: NVIDIA/OpenShell
raw_excerpt: OpenShell is the safe, private runtime for autonomous AI agents.
summary: NVIDIA 在 GitHub 开源 OpenShell，定位为面向自主 AI 智能体的安全、私有运行时环境。它为智能体提供隔离执行空间，防止其越权访问系统资源或泄露数据，单日即获超 1200 星。随着智能体开始直接操作文件、终端与网络，运行时安全成为部署瓶颈，NVIDIA 此举意在为自家生态补齐智能体执行层的安全底座，也可能成为行业事实标准。
